prompt.title: Name the roles you play
prompt.chapterReference: Habit 2: Begin with the End in Mind
prompt.text: List the parts you play in life: at home, at work, with friends, for yourself. Rate how each one is going, and say whether you like the picture.
prompt.glossText: The book asks you to look at your life as a set of roles, so that no single one crowds out the rest.
prompt.whyItMatters: It's easy to pour everything into one role and forget the others until something breaks. Seeing them side by side shows what's getting your time and what isn't. Your mission and your weekly plan both start from this list.

list.empty: No roles yet. Start with the one you'd hate to get wrong.
list.tooManyHint: More than seven roles gets hard to hold in your head. Could two of these be one?

form.namePrompt: What part do you play? One or two words.
form.descriptionPrompt: One line on what this role means to you.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Being around, not just providing.
form.satisfactionPrompt: Right now, how happy are you with how you're doing in this role? 1 is not at all, 5 is very.
form.notePrompt: Is this the picture you want? If not, what's missing?
form.notePlaceholder: e.g. Not yet. I'm there for homework, not for fun.
form.builtInHint: This role comes with the app. You can describe and rate it, but not rename or remove it.

goals.empty: No goals yet. What would make this role a success in a year?

goal.whatPrompt: In this role, what do you want to be true a while from now?
goal.whatPlaceholder: e.g. One evening a week that's just us, phones away.
goal.whatRequired: Write what you want to reach first.
goal.whyPlaceholder: e.g. She's twelve. In a few years she won't want to.
goal.howPrompt: What will you see or hear when you've got there?
goal.howPlaceholder: e.g. She suggests what we do, not me.

steps.prompt: What's the first small thing? Up to five.
steps.placeholder: e.g. Ask her which evening works.
steps.maxHint: Five is plenty. Finish one before adding more.

checklist.note: Write whether this is the picture you want
checklist.goal: Give one role a goal with a first step

guide.inShort: You'll list the roles you play and rate how each is going. Ten minutes. The list feeds your mission statement and, later, your weekly plan. Sharpen the Saw, looking after yourself, is added for you.
howTo: Tap "Add role" and name one part you play: Dad, Team lead, Friend, Neighbour.
Add a line on what the role means to you. A colour helps you spot it later.
Rate how it's going, 1 to 5. Be honest; nobody else sees it.
Write whether this is the picture you want, and what's missing if not.
For your most important roles, add a goal: what you want to reach, why, and how you'll know. Give it one first step.
Tap "Mark done" once three roles are rated and one has a note.

guide.afterwards: Look at the lowest rating. That's where your week probably needs a goal. Come back after your mission statement and re-rate; the numbers move once the roles get real attention.
